heading_path: 5.6  Filing of notice of intention to oppose
text: (1) For subsection 52(2) of the Act, the period for filing a notice of intention to oppose is 2 months from the day the acceptance of the trade mark application is published in a computer database maintained by the Trade Marks Office in accordance with regulation 4.11A. (2) The notice must be in an approved form. (3) The Registrar must give a copy of the notice to the applicant.
